name: Athame Artis
desc: A precious sword gifted by the Day King to the brave hero in the little witch's story, only for the witch to take it and defeat the hero herself.

desc.text:
By the time the little witch arrived at the Day King's palace, twilight had already taken hold.
Had she come any later, the kingdom would have already passed beyond the Day King's rule.
Before the night curtain descended, the Day King received her in what remained of his fleeting hours.
"O witch who has traversed the vast cosmos, kindler of time's eternal flame... what brings you to this lonely planet?"
"I did not come of my own accord. It was the planet's cry that found me through the void. Answering its call, I crossed the gate of stars forgotten by time."
"In a universe nearing its quiet end, every world that yet glimmers is a treasure beyond compare..."
"Who would have thought that in a region long considered dark and inhospitable, a living world would still endure?"
But this was not the whole story. In truth, the little witch had caught wind of whispers from this dark expanse — whispers that had flown to her on the eve of the Night Carnival.
Under ordinary circumstances, she would likely have dismissed such strange signals as just another error from the scryglass.
But as the message reached her, she was fretting over the next day's festivities, desperately trying to find a way to avoid her nemesis, who would also be there.
So she seized the opportunity to hide away in her workshop — spending considerable effort deciphering this distant missive.
"Hmm... So this peculiar message means that some unknown planet has been feeling unwell?"
"No matter what, the righteous Kingdom of Day would never do anything to harm the planet," the Day King said solemnly.
"Perhaps you should ask the wicked Night King. This very morning I sent my army to vanquish him, alas..."
But before he could finish, the last rays of the setting sun vanished into night, and the king's apparition melted away like cream.
With the curtain of darkness descending, the court itself vanished too. The ground boiled like a raging sea, and black smoke rose from the earth.
The entire planet became a vast black ocean. Fortunately, the little witch had remembered her broom — otherwise, she may well have plunged into the water.
Riding her broom beneath the blood-red moon, she traveled far before finally spying a lonely castle, glowing with firelight.
"Vanquish the Night King? That's the easy part. What we have to do is far more important."
The castle seemed to have been built by the Day King's army. For unknown reasons, it had escaped dissolution by the sea of mist.
The leading warrior, carrying a sword on his back, was not at all surprised by the little witch's arrival. Instead, he met her with an invitation.
"Even if we defeat the Night King, it changes nothing. As soon as the sun sets anew, the dark tides will swallow the land once more."
"To break this endless cycle, we built this castle. From here, we can search for a solution."
At his invitation, the little witch descended to the deepest level of the castle, where — beyond its fragile boundaries — stretched a sea of pure darkness.
Sustaining this boundary was a massive mechanism that spat out an endless stream of smoke. Countless pipes were continuously drawing thick seawater into its core.
"This is the perpetual motion machine, or you may call it the Holy Grail. By burning the seawater, it generates light and heat."
"Since all tangible things on this planet are merely shadows cast by light, so long as we can create a fire that never goes out..."
"But doing this will only make the planet burn out even faster..." the little witch sighed.
"Once the sea's been drained, this place will be finished. There's nothing 'holy' about this so-called grail..."
"Now I know why the planet's been feeling unwell."
Before the warrior could react, the little witch drew the sword from his back and hurled it into the "perpetual motion machine."
The warrior reached out to retrieve it, but the moment the blade touched the black sea mist, both he and the fading light vanished into nothingness.
The entire planet was once again swallowed by darkness. When daylight finally returned, it was as if everything from the previous night had been nothing more than a deep and distant dream.
"I suppose that's a temporary fix, at least," the little witch murmured, glancing back one last time before leaving the planet on her broom.
In the morning light, the warrior — his shadow trailing long behind him — took up the sword bestowed by the Day King and set out on his journey once more.
"This cycle may go on for a long, long time... until the day you too become nothing but an empty shell."
"But no matter what, you must keep going. At least... you must live until we meet again."

materials.name: Tile of Decarabian's Tower
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The place now known as Stormterror's Lair was once the capital city of Decarabian, the God of Storms. Since this dream of prosperity was created entirely by his divine might, the broken pieces left behind by the shattering of that dream still possess great power.

materials.name: Frostnight's Glimmer
materials.desc:
A fragment taken from the horned crown of a defeated Frostnight Scion.
Legend has it that in the distant past, these noble creatures were servants to the Golden City, their eyes reflecting the holiest and brightest light of heaven. That light has long since been extinguished, but these scions that lost their master still roam beneath the frosty moon, keeping an oath that no one now remembers.

materials.name: Broken Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The drive shaft of a Landcruiser destroyed in battle.
Even the most precise craftsmanship cannot withstand excessive wear, just as the most lofty ideals cannot bring back those who've died in vain for someone else's cause. Moreover, mass-produced components can hardly be called precise, and mass-produced ideals can hardly be considered true ideals.

materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Decarabian, the God of Storms, was content with the capital city he had raised, and accepted the worship of the people from atop his tower. But he knew not that the people did not bow to him out of respect or adoration.

materials.name: Frostnight's Glow
materials.desc:
A chunk taken from the horned crown of a defeated Frostnight Scion.
In the oldest sagas of the Frostmoon Scions, the glow of these noble creatures was described as the "unsullied mercy of the divine emissary" by the philosophers of the far north. Though this mercy could not prevent the fall of the Golden City or save her descendants from exile, the same glow still courses through their horned crowns, waiting for a dream that may never return.

materials.name: Reinforced Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The reinforced drive shaft of a Landcruiser.
It took countless reports of destruction to bring about this insignificant improvement. In a sense, the administrative system of the Royal Armory Palace is several times more complex than the machinery it builds. After all, even the most advanced Landcruisers don't take months or even years to build.

materials.name: Fragment of Decarabian's Epic
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Andrius once declared war upon Decarabian, but failed to even scratch the capital of the Lord of the Tower. If it were not for the song of freedom that shattered the city in an instant, Decarabian's dream would have gone on forever.

materials.name: Frostnight's Glory
materials.desc:
A bone plate taken from the horned crown of a defeated Frostnight Scion.
A warmth as glossy as moonlight envelopes it, radiating strongly even in the dead of winter nights. In a sense, just like the Frostmoon Scions, this is the last thing these noble creatures stand by. The master they once served has been reduced to dust, yet their dreams still glow with golden splendor.

materials.name: Precision Drive Shaft
materials.desc:
The drive shaft of a Landcruiser refined by the Design Bureau.
On the blueprints drawn by the engineers of the north, this unassuming part was once the flawless embodiment of glory and technological advancement, its small metal body encapsulating the wisdom of countless generations. Now it lies in the cold dirt, waiting to be recycled once more.

materials.name: Scattered Piece of Decarabian's Dream
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
The people did not bow to Decarabian out of respect or adoration, but because the harsh winds had laid them low. This was the shattered dream and ambition of the Anemo Archon before the rise of Barbatos.
He tried so hard to make his dream come true, and so the fragments of that dream are still mighty.

value.text:
CRIT DMG from Elemental Bursts is increased by <color=#37ffff>16/20/24/28/32%</color> . When an Elemental Burst hits an opponent, gain the Blade of the Daylight Hours effect: ATK is increased by <color=#37ffff>20/25/30/35/40%</color> . Nearby active party members other than the equipping character have their ATK increased by <color=#37ffff>16/20/24/28/32%</color> for 3s.
Additionally, when the party possesses Hexerei: Secret Rite effects, the effects of Blade of the Daylight Hours are increased by an additional 75%. This effect can be triggered even if the equipping character is off-field.

customize.name: The Daybreak Chronicles
customize.desc: The songs of resistance come hither on the wind to settle as gentle tones upon these strings, their combined power great enough to rip boundless darkness asunder with the light of the breaking dawn.

customize.name: The Stringless
customize.desc: A bow that once served as an extraordinary instrument. It is no longer capable of getting people up and dancing.

customize.name: The Alley Flash
customize.desc: A straight sword as black as the night. It once belonged to a thief who roamed the benighted streets.

customize.name: Wine and Song
customize.desc: A songbook from the bygone aristocratic era, whose composer has become forgotten. It chronicles the tale of a certain heroic outlaw.

customize.name: Prospector's Drill
customize.desc: A long-handled drill that you can rarely find nowadays. It was often used in delving and in carving stones.

customize.name: Rainslasher
customize.desc: A fluorescent greatsword with no sharp edge that crushes enemies with brute force and raw power.
